purpose: Versioned Bing AI Performance manual CSV snapshots for article planning and refresh
update_procedure: Never overwrite existing date folders. Save each new original export plus manifest in a separate YYYY-MM-DD folder; update latest_snapshot and append snapshots after verifying original bytes and SHA256. Old snapshots are immutable. A dated folder may contain fewer than three CSVs when only some report types were exported.
usage: Before article planning/refresh, check latest available snapshot(s), relevant CSV data and matching observation periods. The 2026-10-19 export contains one grounding-query report; for topic opportunity reports refer to the 2026-10-14 historical files. Cross-check with current GSC/Bing data, manufacturer documentation and Bing Pages attribution.
restrictions: Keep this metadata archival. Do not deploy as public site content or misstate market ranges as site citations.
